conservative.read: This conservative plan targets capital preservation with a potential ~1.5%/month return. It significantly reduces risk by eliminating leveraged ETFs and lowering concentration, but still carries market exposure.

balanced.read: This balanced plan aims for risk-first growth, targeting ~2.5%/month. It reduces overall leverage and concentration while maintaining exposure to quality tech and broad indices, accepting moderate market risk.

aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets stretch growth, aiming for ~4%/month. It significantly increases exposure to leveraged ETFs and concentrates in high-scoring setups, leading to potentially higher returns but also much larger drawdowns and daily decay risk. Strict stop discipline is critical.

plan: Sell SOXL and SPAL to zero to eliminate all leveraged ETF exposure.
Trim SPY to 20% to reduce concentration and meet the single-name mandate.
Trim CRWD to 5% and sell SMH to zero to reduce high-beta exposure.

income.read: This income plan prioritizes steady monthly distributions, targeting ~1%/month. It significantly reduces growth-oriented and leveraged positions, focusing on income-generating ETFs and broad indices. While aiming for lower drawdown, NAV can still fall in market selloffs, and distributions are not guaranteed.
